format: Studio/Custom team offerings (Team, Formation team, Team match, Studio team)
requirement: Team offerings are DanceFlow Studio/Custom formats named 'Studio/Custom: ...' with no governing-body name or compliance implication; team size 2 to 100, pricing, identifiers and scoring selection are unchanged.
enforcement_point: TypeScript display layer (see OD19-STUDIO-CUSTOM-FORMAT-LABELS). Known gap: the category name saved for new setups is built by public.create_competition_draft from the immutable SQL profile and still reads 'Formation' / 'Team Match' / 'Team'.

tests.name: labels carry no governing-body name and keep the persisted ids
team size 2 to 100, roles, pairing, pricing models and every non-display field are unchanged
pricing derives identically and the payload carries ids only

interpretation_notes: Unverified for the same reason as OD19-STUDIO-CUSTOM-FORMAT-LABELS (persisted names). Scoring finding: team offerings inherit the style's judging; Ballroom Formation and Team Match resolve to the Studio ordinal majority engine (Placements), Country Team (Medal Marks, legacy 'custom') and a Studio team judged by Ratings fail closed with no calculable result. No NDCA cumulative-point scoring exists. Readiness caveat (pre-existing, not team-specific): a draft round with no calculable method is only a readiness NOTICE (COMP_SCORING_NO_METHOD), publishing is not blocked, and the readiness page can show the scoring row as Ready, so a Country Team or a Custom team judged by Ratings can be published without ever producing results. A capability guard is reported separately and not implemented.
